functions: followLine (defined at b4, called at b3)
control_flow: followLine: if LLIGHT is below 50 % (dim light), curve left; else curve right.

decision_points.condition: the light from above (LLIGHT) is below 50 % (dim light)

branches.outcome: dim light (below 50 %): the robot curves left
bright light (50 % or more): the robot curves right

input_dimensions.dimension: the light where the robot is
the light where the robot is

scenarios.coded_response: In bright light it curves right without end; in dim light (in a tunnel) it curves left without end.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is on the floor in bright light, or inside a tunnel where the light from above is dim.
scenarios.title: Steers by the light from above
assumptions: You said to follow the line, but the program can't sense lines, and you didn't say what it should do with the light it reads.

uncertainties: You said to follow the line, but the program reads only the left light sensor from above (LLIGHT), not the line tracker: lines on the floor change nothing for it, so it can't follow a line.
In bright light it curves right without end; only inside a tunnel (dim light) does it curve left, and you didn't say what it should do there.
The light sensor only reads dim light inside a tunnel, so the dim-light path can only be set up by starting inside a tunnel.

outcomes.words: the condition doesn't hold: the else part runs
